label: MovieSerifText_5c_0003_M
deu: Ab heute führe ich\ndie Befreiungsfront an!
eng: I'm gonna take over the SLF!
esp: ¡Voy a ser el nuevo líder\ndel FLS!
fra: Je vais prendre le contrôle du\nFront de Libération des Sushis !

label: MovieSerifText_5c_0003_F
eng: I'm gonna take over the SLF!
esp: ¡Voy a ser la nueva líder\ndel FLS!

label: MovieSerifText_5c_0004_M
deu: In unserer Republik soll kein\nEssen verschwendet werden!
eng: In our Republic, I'll make sure\nno food goes to waste!
esp: En nuestra República\n¡no se desperdiciará la comida!
fra: Je ferai en sorte que jamais plus\nla nourriture ne soit gâchée !
nld: In onze Republiek zal geen\neten verspild worden!
tur: Cumhuriyetimizde hiçbir yemeğin\nisraf olmasına izin vermeyeceğim!

label: MovieSerifText_5c_0004_F
eng: In our Republic, I'll make sure\nno food goes to waste!
tur: Cumhuriyetimizde hiçbir yemeğin\nisraf olmasına izin vermeyeceğim!

label: MovieSerifText_5c_0009_M
deu: Dein Kampfgeist,\nund deine Liebe zu Sushi...
esp: Tu voluntad y tu gran respeto\npor el sushi
fra: Ta détermination... et ton\namour pour les sushis...
ita: La tua determinazione e il tuo\nassoluto rispetto per il sushi
nld: Je doorzettingsvermogen\nen je liefde voor sushi...
tur: Azmin... ve suşiye duyduğun\no derin sevgi...

label: MovieSerifText_5c_0011_M
fra: La puissance de ma véritable\nforme coule à nouveau en moi !
ita: Ecco la mia più potente\nforma risvegliata!

label: MovieSerifText_5c_0014_M
deu: Siehst du so in\nWirklichkeit aus, Jinrai?
eng: Is this how you're supposed\nto look, Jinrai?!
ita: Questo è il tuo vero\naspetto, Jinrai?!
nld: Is dit je echte vorm, Jinrai?

label: MovieSerifText_5c_0014_F
eng: Is this how you're supposed\nto look, Jinrai?!

label: MovieSerifText_5c_0015_M
eng: No, this form is still imperfect.
fra: Non, je n'ai pas encore retrouvé\ntous mes pouvoirs.
nld: Nee, deze vorm is\nnog niet volmaakt.

label: MovieSerifText_5c_0015_F
eng: No, this form is still imperfect.

label: MovieSerifText_5c_0016_M
eng: I don't care! You look cool!
fra: Pas grave ! T'as l'air trop cool !
nld: Maakt niet uit,\nik vind je cool zo.

label: MovieSerifText_5c_0016_F
eng: I don't care! You look cool!

label: MovieSerifText_5c_0017_M
deu: Also los! Wir machen die\nImperialen zur Schnecke!
eng: All right! Come on, let's go beat\ndown the Imperial Army!
fra: Allez, c'est parti ! On va botter\nles fesses de l'armée impériale !
ita: Bene! Forza, andiamo a suonarle\nall'esercito imperiale!
nld: Kom op! We gaan het Keizerrijk\nin de pan hakken!

label: MovieSerifText_5c_0017_F
eng: All right! Come on, let's go beat\ndown the Imperial Army!

label: MovieSerifText_5c_0020_M
ita: Ehi! Perché sei tornato\nalla forma di prima?!

label: MovieSerifText_5c_0021_M
eng: Being small is a little more\nconvenient for me.
fra: Au quotidien, il est plus pratique\npour moi d'être petit.
tur: Küçük hâlim benim için\nbiraz daha pratik.

label: MovieSerifText_5c_0022_M
fra: Et je suis bien plus mimi.

label: MovieSerifText_5c_0023_M
deu: Und ich kann bei dir\nauf dem Kopf sitzen!
eng: Also, I can ride on your head.
fra: Et je peux me poser sur ta tête.
nld: En ik kan op je hoofd meeliften!
